text:
**Not yet confirmed, and persistence can't be assessed.**

- **What was detected:** Hansen GFC shows 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025, which is 3.91% of the 345.6 ha asset.
- **Reference agreement:** JRC GFC2020 maps 98% of the event area as forest in 2020, which is well above the 50% threshold. The MGAP 2021 map classifies 13.1 ha as native forest, 0.4 ha as outside mapped forest and none as planted.
- **Why it's unconfirmed:** The corroboration rule needs a later year of the series to be observed as well as JRC agreement. The series ends in 2025, so no later year exists for this event. Persistence can't be checked until 2026 data is available.

The loss is credible, since it is on previously forested land and well above the minimum event size. Treat it as a single-year detection pending follow-up.

Also, the engine is early-access (land-change/1).
